retracted_this_round.claim: MIRROR_ARM_FAIL / GESTURE_REGRESSION: dragging outside the map does not scroll the page, so the sentence 想翻这一页就拖地图以外的地方 is false (run gz3)
retracted_this_round.why_wrong: my mirror arm used (-90,-60), a horizontal-dominant drag. Matrix run mtx2 measured a short PURE-vertical (0,-60) scrolling DOCUMENT 0->45 and a vertical-dominant (-60,-90) scrolling 0->78, while horizontal-dominant (-90,-60) never scrolled at start y 179 or 500, nor with 24 sub-steps. Direction, not length, decides whether the browser treats a touch drag as a page scroll. The product was never at fault.
retracted_this_round.also: an earlier mirror-arm target was taken from an element's geometric centre, and a tall header container's centre sat inside the map canvas (195,740), so the 'off-map' drag was pressing the map. Fixed by requiring elementFromPoint at the exact coordinate to resolve outside .v8-map-panel, above the canvas top, and not onto a nav/button/fixed bar.
